dialog.english: ��������Where did Matt go...?
dialog.translation:
Dónde se habrá metido
Matt...?

dialog.english:
Don't worry, T.K. Matt isn't
the type to leave his friends
behind.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes, T.K. Matt
no es de los que abandona
a sus amigos.

dialog.english:
There's probably stuff he needs to
do by himself, but I'm sure he'll
come back.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que tiene cosas que
hacer solo, pero volverá,
seguro.

dialog.english: Yeah...
dialog.translation: Sí...

dialog.english: (Right, Matt...?)
dialog.translation: (Verdad, Matt...?)

dialog.english:
Tai, I also believe that we
should trust in Matt, but...
dialog.translation:
Tai, yo también creo que
debemos confiar en Matt,
pero...

dialog.english:
Matt may have gotten into some
kind of trouble, so shouldn't we
search around here?
dialog.translation:
Puede que Matt esté en algún
lío, no deberíamos buscar
por aquí?

dialog.english:
I agree. This is Pinocchimon's
territory, so we should join up as
soon as we can.
dialog.translation:
De acuerdo. Esto es
territorio de Puppetmon,
hay que reunirse cuanto antes.

dialog.english:
All right, guys! Let's get going!
We're looking for Matt!
dialog.translation:
Vale, chicos! En marcha!
Buscamos a Matt!

dialog.english: Look, Tai! It's a Koromon.
dialog.translation: Mira, Tai! Es un Koromon.

dialog.english: It looks hurt...
dialog.translation: Parece herido...

dialog.english:
Hey! Koromon, what happened to
you?!
dialog.translation:
Eh! Koromon, qué te ha
pasado?!

dialog.english:
T-the Dark Masters... attacked...
the village...
dialog.translation:
L-los Amos Oscuros...
atacaron... la aldea...

dialog.english:
So the Dark Masters have hurt even
more Digimon...
dialog.translation:
Así que los Amos Oscuros
hirieron a más Digimon...

dialog.english:
When it ran away from the village,
it must have gotten separated from
its friends...
dialog.translation:
Al huir de la aldea, seguro
que se separó de sus
amigos...

dialog.english:
We can't just leave it alone! Not
when it's injured like this!
dialog.translation:
No podemos dejarlo solo!
No estando así de herido!

dialog.english:
Let's find the other Koromon and
bring them together!
dialog.translation:
Busquemos a los otros
Koromon y reunámoslos!

dialog.english: Yeah, I know.
dialog.translation: Sí, lo sé.

dialog.english:
We'll find Matt for sure. But
right now, we have to help the
Koromon!
dialog.translation:
Encontraremos a Matt,
seguro. Pero ahora hay que
ayudar al Koromon!

dialog.english: Here... everyone...
dialog.translation: Aquí... todos...

dialog.english:
Anyone...? There's an injured
Koromon. Is anyone here...?
dialog.translation:
Hola...? Hay un Koromon
herido. Hay alguien aquí...?

dialog.english: Thank you for helping our friend!
dialog.translation:
Gracias, salvaste a
nuestro amigo

dialog.english: What on earth happened?
dialog.translation: Qué diablos pasó?

dialog.english:
Pinocchimon attacked our village,
and we all ran, but...
dialog.translation:
Puppetmon atacó nuestra
aldea, y todos huimos,
pero...

dialog.english:
We can't live in our village
anymore. It was destroyed.
dialog.translation:
Ya no podemos vivir en
nuestra aldea. La destruyeron.

dialog.english: ...Unforgivable.
dialog.translation: ...Imperdonable.

dialog.english: How's that injured one doing?
dialog.translation: Cómo está el herido?

dialog.english:
The wounds are deep... we need
medicinal herbs, but we don't have
any anymore.
dialog.translation:
Las heridas son graves...
necesitamos hierbas
medicinales, y no nos quedan.

dialog.english:
I'll go look for some. Stay here
and wait for me, guys.
dialog.translation:
Iré a buscar unas cuantas.
Quedaos aquí y esperadme.

dialog.english: I'm going with you!
dialog.translation: Voy contigo!

dialog.english: Me, too!
dialog.translation: También!

dialog.english: All right, then let's hurry!
dialog.translation: Vale, pues démonos prisa!

dialog.english:
The herb should be a red flower
that's bigger than us. It should
be near here.
dialog.translation:
La hierba es una flor roja
más grande que nosotros.
Debe de estar cerca.

dialog.english:
It's hard to find, so keep that in
mind.
dialog.translation:
Cuesta encontrarla,
tenedlo en cuenta.

dialog.english: Ah! Tai, look!
dialog.translation: Ah! Tai, mira!

dialog.english:
Isn't that what the Koromon was
talking about? A red flower bigger
than a Koromon?
dialog.translation:
No es de eso de lo que
hablaba el Koromon? Una flor
roja más grande que él?

dialog.english:
You're right! It was pretty far
away, though. Good job finding it,
Kari.
dialog.translation:
Tienes razón! Aunque estaba
bastante lejos. Buen ojo,
Kari.

dialog.english: You have good eyes.
dialog.translation: Tienes buena vista.

dialog.english: Eheheh...
dialog.translation: Jejeje...

dialog.english:
It's 'cause you're always watching
TV with Dad...
dialog.translation:
Es que ves la tele con
papá todo el rato...

dialog.english: T-that's not it!
dialog.translation: N-no es eso!

dialog.english: Obtained herb!
dialog.translation: Hierba lista!

dialog.english: Obtained herb!
dialog.translation: Hierba lista!

dialog.english: Obtained herb!
dialog.translation: Hierba lista!

dialog.english:
Thank you! We can help all our
injured ones with this!
dialog.translation:
Gracias! Con esto podremos
ayudar a todos los heridos!

dialog.english: Has Matt still not returned?
dialog.translation: Matt sigue sin volver?

dialog.english: ...Nope.
Huh...
dialog.translation: Eh...

dialog.english:
What should we do, Tai? Should
we wait here for Matt?
dialog.translation:
Qué hacemos, Tai? Esperamos
aquí a Matt?

dialog.english:
Or should we find a place where we
can stave off the Dark Masters?
dialog.translation:
O buscamos un sitio donde
plantar cara a los Amos
Oscuros?

dialog.english:
Let's go... I don't want to make
any more Digimon into victims.
dialog.translation:
Vamos... no quiero que haya
más Digimon víctimas.

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english: I agree!
dialog.translation: Vale!

dialog.english:
Thank you so much! Our Koromon
will get better...
dialog.translation:
Muchas gracias! Nuestro
Koromon se pondrá bien...

dialog.english:
We want you to receive this in
gratitude!
dialog.translation:
Queremos daros esto en
agradecimiento!

dialog.english:
Thank you! We'll take it. We'll
defeat the Dark Masters, for sure!
dialog.translation:
Gracias! Lo aceptamos.
Venceremos a los Amos
Oscuros, seguro!

dialog.english: Leave it to us!
dialog.translation: A por ello!

dialog.english:
I have to do my brother's share
too, so I'll do my best!
dialog.translation:
Hago también lo de mi
hermano, así que me
esforzaré!

dialog.english:
You're getting really dependable,
T.K.
dialog.translation:
Cada vez eres más fiable,
T.K.

dialog.english: U-ugh...
dialog.translation: U-ugh...

dialog.english:
It's having a nightmare... its
eyes are full of fear...
dialog.translation:
Tiene una pesadilla... sus
ojos están llenos de
miedo

dialog.english:
We could make it easier for him if
we had the herb...
dialog.translation:
Sería más fácil para él si
tuviéramos la hierba...

dialog.english:
The herb should be a red flower
that's bigger than us. It should
be nearby.
dialog.translation:
La hierba es una flor roja
más grande que nosotros.
Debe de estar cerca.

dialog.english:
It's hard to find, so keep that in
mind.
dialog.translation:
Cuesta encontrarla,
tenedlo en cuenta.

dialog.english: Got it. We'll keep an eye out.
dialog.translation:
Entendido. Estaremos
atentos.

dialog.english:
Are you gonna fight the Dark
Masters? They're a lot scarier
than Etemon.
dialog.translation:
Vais a luchar contra los
Amos Oscuros? Dan mucho
más miedo que Etemon.

dialog.english:
Yeah, we'll fight whoever we have
to fight.
dialog.translation:
Sí, lucharemos contra quien
sea necesario.

dialog.english:
If we had more of the herb, we'd
share it with you...
dialog.translation:
Si tuviéramos más hierba,
la compartiríamos...

dialog.english: We're fine. Don't worry about us.
dialog.translation:
Estamos bien. No os
preocupéis.

dialog.english: I can't poop properly like this...
dialog.translation:
Así no puedo hacer caca
bien...

dialog.english: Why do you think Matt left?
dialog.translation:
Por qué crees que se fue
Matt

dialog.english: (I have no idea...)
dialog.translation: (Ni idea...)

dialog.english: (I have an idea.)
dialog.translation: (Yo sí sé.)

dialog.english:
I *never* have any idea what he's
thinking!
dialog.translation:
Nunca tengo ni idea de qué
piensa!

dialog.english:
Don't say things like that,
Tai.
dialog.translation: No digas esas cosas, Tai.

dialog.english: He's a pretty blunt guy.
dialog.translation: Es bastante brusco.

dialog.english:
He probably didn't know what to do
for himself, rather than what to
do for T.K.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que no sabía qué
hacer con él mismo, más que
qué hacer con T.K.

dialog.english:
I guess Matt really does keep
everyone in mind...
dialog.translation:
Supongo que Matt sí piensa
en todos...

dialog.english:
That's why I'm sure he'll come
back!
dialog.translation:
Por eso seguro que
volverá!

dialog.english: We've gotten separated...
dialog.translation: Nos hemos separado...

dialog.english: I'm counting on you, Izzy.
dialog.translation: Cuento contigo, Izzy.

dialog.english: We're separated, but still friends.
dialog.translation:
Separados, pero seguimos
amigos.

dialog.english:
I'm grateful for your confidence
in me, but it's a little too much
for me to handle...
dialog.translation:
Agradezco tu confianza en
mí, pero es un poco
demasiado para mí...

dialog.english:
That's true... we've fought
together as comrades up until now.
dialog.translation:
Es verdad... hemos luchado
juntos como compañeros
hasta ahora.

dialog.english:
Hey, Tai. Can I stay with the
Koromon?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai. Puedo quedarme
con el Koromon?

dialog.english: You have a mission, right Kari?
dialog.translation:
Tienes una misión, no,
Kari?

dialog.english: We can't leave you behind.
dialog.translation: No podemos dejarte atrás.

dialog.english:
We have to defeat the Dark
Masters.
dialog.translation:
Hay que vencer a los
Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english: Yeah, I know...
dialog.translation: Sí, lo sé...

dialog.english:
That's not what you said
earlier...
dialog.translation:
Eso no es lo que dijiste
antes...

dialog.english:
I just wanted to know if you'd try
to take me with you.
dialog.translation:
Solo quería saber si
tratarías de llevarme
conmigo.

dialog.english:
We can't leave you behind, you
know.
dialog.translation:
No podemos dejarte atrás,
lo sabes.

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english:
What if you get targeted after we
leave...?
dialog.translation:
Y si te atacan cuando nos
vayamos...?

dialog.english:
But aren't you worried about the
Koromon?
dialog.translation:
Pero no te preocupa el
Koromon?

dialog.english: You have to understand, Kari...
dialog.translation:
Tienes que entenderlo,
Kari...

dialog.english:
We're gonna need more herbs than
that if we want to cure those
wounds.
dialog.translation:
Necesitaremos más hierbas
que esas para curar esas
heridas.
